answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 17 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 406 identities costs 406 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The jade of the design is public, the orchard of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the kernel of honest work is what finally pays.
